svg.title: Inference workflows and shared prediction code
svg.desc: The sample CLI command calls generate.py. It loads a checkpoint, prepares requested length, charge and hydrophobicity conditions, calls predict.py with DDIM and saves sequences.fasta, candidates.jsonl and generation.json. The generate CLI command calls design.py. It reads the target through targets.py, generates Complexa scaffolds through complexa.py or accepts supplied scaffolds, ranks and selects them, and uses Foldseek to encode their 3Di. checkpoint.py loads the design model and its configuration. inpainting.py optionally builds a kept-residue seed and checks that candidates preserve it. redesign_batching.py batches candidates across scaffolds, while structural_guidance.py wraps the U-Net to steer structure. The design route calls predict.py with DDPM, folds accepted candidates with their target using ESMFold2 and ranks the results, saving sequences, scores, metadata and structures. Both workflows share predict.py, which delegates reverse sampling to diffusion using the model callback, decodes vectors with dataset/decode.py, and returns Prediction containing both vectors and decoded records. provider.py optionally keeps the Complexa and folding services loaded between runs. complexa_service.py manages complexa_worker.py; folding_service.py manages esmfold2_worker.py. The same predict.py tab is repeated at its two call sites and expanded below.
